mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS entry_count,COALESCE(SUM(bytes+residue_bytes),0) AS media_bytes FROM song_cache_entry
SELECT id,bytes,residue_bytes,state,delete_token FROM song_cache_entry

SELECT e.id,e.song_id,e.media_type,e.bytes,e.residue_bytes,e.created_at,e.last_access_at,e.hits,e.state,e.target_json,, (SELECT MIN(e0.created_at) FROM song_cache_entry e0 WHERE e0.song_id=e.song_id) AS first_cached_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playback_history h WHERE h.song_id=e.song_id AND h.effective_at>=#{since} AND h.effective_at<=#{now} AND h.client_type<>'ADMIN') AS plays_7d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playback_attempt a WHERE a.song_id=e.song_id AND a.started_playing_at IS NOT NULL AND a.lease_until>#{now} AND a.state IN ('PLAYING','PAUSED','BUFFERING')) AS playing_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song_cache_lease l JOIN song_cache_entry e2 ON e2.id=l.cache_id WHERE e2.song_id=e.song_id AND l.renewed_at>#{now}-120000) AS lease_count FROM (SELECT id,song_id,media_type,bytes,residue_bytes,created_at,last_access_at,hits,state,target_json FROM song_cache_entry ORDER BY last_access_at DESC,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}) e LEFT JOIN song_playback_profile p ON p.song_id=e.song_id ORDER BY e.last_access_at DESC,e.id

SELECT e.id,e.song_id,e.bytes,e.residue_bytes,e.created_at,c.first_cached_at,e.last_access_at,e.state,,COALESCE(f.plays_7d,0) AS plays_7d,COALESCE(a.playing_count,0) AS playing_count,COALESCE(l.lease_count,0) AS lease_count FROM song_cache_entry e LEFT JOIN song_playback_profile p ON p.song_id=e.song_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT song_id,MIN(created_at) AS first_cached_at FROM song_cache_entry GROUP BY song_id) c ON c.song_id=e.song_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT song_id,COUNT(*) AS plays_7d FROM playback_history WHERE effective_at>=#{since} AND effective_at<=#{now} AND client_type<>'ADMIN' GROUP BY song_id) f ON f.song_id=e.song_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT song_id,COUNT(*) AS playing_count FROM playback_attempt WHERE started_playing_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_until>#{now} AND state IN ('PLAYING','PAUSED','BUFFERING') GROUP BY song_id) a ON a.song_id=e.song_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT e2.song_id,COUNT(*) AS lease_count FROM song_cache_lease l2 JOIN song_cache_entry e2 ON e2.id=l2.cache_id WHERE l2.renewed_at>#{now}-120000 GROUP BY e2.song_id) l ON l.song_id=e.song_id WHERE e.state='ACTIVE'

UPDATE song_playback_profile SET pinned=#{pinned},pin_revision=pin_revision+1 WHERE song_id=#{song} AND pin_revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM song_cache_entry e WHERE e.song_id=p.song_id) AS cache_count FROM song_playback_profile p WHERE p.pinned=1 ORDER BY p.song_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
